note: Chronic Disease Management Program, List of Funding Recipients (OSDH, read 2026-10-02). Midwest Rural Chronic Care Connect (RC3) is a telehealth-enabled chronic disease management program serving rural Oklahoma statewide. Operating a centralized care-coordination and telehealth hub, RC3 uses a dual model: for the many rural patients with no established medical home, RC3 connects them to primary care; for patients who already have a PCP or psychiatrist, RC3 coordinates with that provider. RC3 deploys evidence-based interventions — self-measured blood pressure monitoring (Million Hearts), Diabetes Self-Management Education and Support (DSMES), spirometry- guided COPD/asthma management (GOLD/NHLBI), and the Collaborative Care Model for co- occurring depression and anxiety, in addition to cellular-connected remote monitoring devices.
